    Examples

    Example: ChangeDecimalToValueExample

    [Video example](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/reference/ChangeDecimalToValueExample-1.mp4)

    ```
    from manim import *

    class ChangeDecimalToValueExample(Scene):
        def construct(self):
            number = DecimalNumber(0)
            self.add(number)
            self.play(ChangeDecimalToValue(number, 10, run_time=3))
            self.wait()
    ```
